services.title: Our Services
services.eyebrow: What we do · From analysis to ops
services.intro: We offer comprehensive IT and hardware consultancy services tailored to your business needs. Our expertise lies in holistic software solutions, project management, and electronics.
services.description: We have extensive experience with small and large software solutions, from dozens to millions of users. Additionally, we have experience with electronics solutions, from specification and certification to implementation and design.

about.title: About Us
about.lead: Purpeon Digital is an innovative consultancy firm, and our consultants have many years of experience helping businesses navigate the complexity of modern technology.
about.description1: Extensive experience from various industries, both public and private sector, gives us unique insight into the challenges businesses face today.
about.description2: With expertise spanning both IT and hardware, we are in a unique position to offer comprehensive technology solutions.
about.description3: The name Purpeon Digital originates from the flower foxglove (Digitalis purpurea), which was also the county flower of Sogn og Fjordane, thus reflecting our local connection and identity.

team.lede: We're a small, seasoned team with long experience from both large enterprises and early-stage startups. Together we cover software, infrastructure, and electronics, and we take on both short engagements and longer collaborations.

members.name: Dagfinn Olav Marsfjell Reiakvam
members.bio: Dagfinn is our managing director and has long experience as an electronics engineer, with deep expertise in embedded systems and IoT solutions. He has worked on everything from prototyping to mass production, and has a good handle on both hardware and software.

members.name: Finn Michael "Fimmi" Halvorsen
members.bio: Fimmi holds an MSc in communications technology and has long experience as a full-stack developer. He has worked on everything from small projects to large enterprise solutions, and has a solid grasp of modern technology.

members.name: Kjell Inge Rotnes
members.bio: Kjell Inge is a co-owner and has long experience as a software developer and architect, with deep expertise in scalable solutions and cloud infrastructure.

members.name: Roger Karlsen
members.bio: Roger is a co-owner of Purpeon and has experience as a software developer in the banking and energy sectors. He was an early adopter of AI and already has several years of experience with AI development and autonomous agents.

references.lede: Our clients work in everything from aquaculture technology in Belgium to electrical and automation on the Norwegian west coast. Here are some of the ones we work closely with.

clients.name: Vision3F
clients.description: Vision3F is transforming Atlantic salmon farming with V-Tag — AI-driven, real-time health monitoring that takes fish farming from reactive to predictive. Purpeon supports the team with software development and cloud infrastructure, from data pipelines to production-ready services.

clients.name: Sætren
clients.description: Sætren delivers smart, safe and future-oriented electrical and automation services — from installations in buildings to industrial automation. Purpeon contributes IoT hardware design, integration and cloud solutions to one of their innovation projects.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.eyebrow: Ready to chat · Tech, projects or advice
contact.lead: Ready to transform your business with technology? Get in touch with our team today.
contact.description: We are here to answer your questions and provide expert guidance on your IT initiatives. Whether you need a consultation, have a specific project in mind, or simply want to learn more about our services, we would love to hear from you.
